A typical year has 365 days.

The described data breach is highly impactful due to the sensitive nature of the compromised information. The exposure of medical histories and treatment information, combined with personal identifiers like names and health insurance details, creates a severe risk for both identity theft and insurance fraud. For the 200,000 affected individuals, this breach not only threatens their financial security but also violates their medical privacy, potentially leading to long-term consequences such as incorrect medical records or denial of coverage.
